prd.system_definition: A dual-state trading engine decoupling Decision (User/Strategy) from Execution (Shadow/Binance), utilizing a unified Risk Engine gatekeeper.

functional_logic.data_arbitration: Normalize external data (e.g., BTCUSDT -> BTC_USDC). Downstream services consume normalized format.

shadow_matching.buy_limit: Fills if Low Price <= Limit Price

functional_logic.risk_policy: Conservative Wins: Enforce smallest result among Account %, Fixed Risk Amount, and Max Size inputs.

slas.data_latency: < 50ms overhead for internal processing (Binance -> Redis -> API)

epic_a_market_data.goal: Implement BinanceDataService to poll Ticker, Depth, and Kline data to Redis
epic_a_market_data.benefit: Prevent rate limits across multiple user sessions

epic_b_shadow_execution.goal: Shadow limit orders remain Open until price crossing
Calculate Shadow P&L using Mark Price
epic_b_shadow_execution.benefit: Avoid P&L noise from spread flickering

epic_c_risk_guardrails.goal: Set Daily Max Drawdown limit to block new entries
Auto-calculate position size based on Entry vs Stop Loss

epic_d_trade_management.goal: Use a visual long/short position tool on the chart to set entry, SL, and TP by dragging
epic_d_trade_management.benefit: Intuitive trade planning with real-time position sizing and R:R calculation

epic_d_trade_management.goal: Have SL/TP orders auto-create when entry fills (not when entry is placed)
epic_d_trade_management.benefit: Never forget to set protective orders after getting filled

epic_d_trade_management.goal: Cancel entry and have linked SL/TP orders auto-cancel
epic_d_trade_management.benefit: Prevent orphaned orders cluttering the order book

epic_d_trade_management.goal: Enable break-even automation that moves SL to entry at X% profit
epic_d_trade_management.benefit: Lock in risk-free trade without manual monitoring

epic_d_trade_management.goal: Set multiple take-profit targets to scale out of positions
epic_d_trade_management.benefit: Capture profits at different levels (e.g., 50% at T1, 25% at T2)

epic_d_trade_management.goal: When SL or TP fills, auto-cancel sibling orders
epic_d_trade_management.benefit: Prevent double-execution and maintain position integrity

epic_e_live_execution.goal: Securely connect Binance API keys to enable live trading
epic_e_live_execution.benefit: Execute real trades on Binance exchange

epic_e_live_execution.goal: Implement Decision Loop that validates shadow orders before live execution
epic_e_live_execution.benefit: Ensure all trades pass risk checks before hitting exchange

epic_e_live_execution.goal: Execute validated orders on Binance via authenticated API
epic_e_live_execution.benefit: Real order placement with proper error handling

epic_e_live_execution.goal: Sync shadow positions with actual Binance positions
epic_e_live_execution.benefit: Maintain consistency between paper and live state

epic_e_live_execution.goal: Toggle between Shadow-only and Live execution modes
epic_e_live_execution.benefit: Practice safely before going live, switch seamlessly

A.1.ttl_check: Redis keys expire automatically if service crashes
A.1.health_check: Log warning if Binance API latency > 500ms

B.1.limit_fill: Buy Limit @ 90,000 fills when Low drops to 89,999
B.1.limit_hold: Buy Limit @ 90,000 remains OPEN if Low is 90,001
B.1.ui_update: Positions table updates instantly on fill without refresh

C.2.violation_check: Manual override to 0.2 triggers 'Risk Violation' warning

position_tool.interaction: Click and drag on chart to create long/short position box
position_tool.real_time_update: All values recalculate as user drags any level

D.0.position_sizing_integration: Uses Risk Engine (Phase C) to calculate size from entry-stop distance

sl_tp_creation.scenario: Entry FILLS at 50000 -> SL order at 49000 and TP order at 52000 auto-created

D.1.timing: SL/TP orders created ONLY after entry fills, not when entry is placed
D.1.order_group_tracking: All linked orders share same order_group_id

D.2.cascade_cancel: Cancel entry order -> All linked SL/TP orders cancelled
D.2.partial_fill: If entry partially filled, only create SL/TP for filled quantity

break_even_scenario.scenario: Price reaches 50500 (1% profit) -> SL moves from 49000 to 50000

D.3.offset_option: Optional offset to move SL slightly above entry (e.g., entry + 10)

D.5.sl_fill_cancels_tp: SL fills at 49000 -> All TP orders auto-cancelled
D.5.tp_fill_cancels_sl: TP fills at 52000 -> SL order auto-cancelled
D.5.partial_tp: Partial TP fill reduces SL quantity proportionally

E.1.key_storage: API keys encrypted at rest, never logged
E.1.key_validation: Test connection validates read permissions before saving
E.1.key_permissions: Minimum required: Spot trading, read balances

decision_flow.step_2: Risk Engine approves (position size, drawdown check)
decision_flow.step_3: If live mode enabled, forward to Binance executor

E.2.rejection_handling: Failed risk check returns detailed reason, order stays in shadow only

E.3.order_mapping: Shadow order -> Binance order format conversion

error_handling.network_error: Retry with timeout, alert user if persistent

E.3.confirmation: Wait for Binance fill confirmation before updating shadow

E.4.sync_trigger: On app start, after each trade, every 60s background
E.4.discrepancy_handling: If Binance position != shadow position, alert user and offer reconciliation
E.4.balance_sync: Update shadow balances from Binance on sync

E.5.mode_toggle: UI switch: Shadow Only | Live Trading
E.5.confirmation: Live mode requires explicit confirmation dialog
E.5.visual_indicator: Clear badge showing current mode (green=shadow, red=live)
